name: authenticate
description: Static Microsoft-issued API token console for auth.dliu.com

scripts.build:lambda: esbuild lambda/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=build/lambda/index.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:lambda && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build-console.mjs --require-config && cdk deploy
